description: Creating Resilient Water Utilities is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. People in water sector utilities can find practical tools, training, and technical assistance to help them adapt to climate change. The program helps water utilities assess vulnerability, plan for extreme weather, and access useful training resources; it p romotes a clear understanding of potential long-term adaptation options. Tools and resources include:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
